Bugs found and fixed in `src/stats.pl`:

1. **`mean`**: divided by `scalar(@values) - 1` instead of the actual count — so `mean(1,2,3)` returned `6/2 = 3` instead of `2`. Fixed to `$sum / scalar(@values)`.
2. **`median`**: two bugs — `sort @_` did lexicographic string sorting (e.g. `10, 9, 2` sorted as `10, 2, 9`), and `int(@sorted / 2)` used the string-ish count with no even-count handling, so `median(10, 9, 2)` could return `2` instead of `9`. Fixed to numeric sort (`sort { $a <=> $b }`), with the standard median: middle element for odd counts, average of the two middle elements for even counts, and `0` for empty input.
